counterexamples.claim: Vin plus reflected output voltage is the complete MOSFET stress.
counterexamples.refutation: The leakage inductance stores 0.5 L_lk I_pk^2 at turn-off. An RCD clamp holds Vds near Vin + V_cl, and the clamp loss scales with V_cl/(V_cl - V_or); ignoring either understates stress and dissipation.

provenance.citation: Erickson and Maksimovic, Fundamentals of Power Electronics

known_traps.trap: Claiming Vds_peak = Vin + N Vout without leakage inductance, clamp voltage or Vds rating.
known_traps.why_shallow_fails: The reflected voltage is only the transformer reset voltage; leakage energy and the clamp set the actual peak and its margin.
known_traps.guard: Require leakage inductance, clamp voltage and the derated Vds rating; keep leakage-driven stress unavailable when those inputs are absent.
